g.text: 5 V priority mux, 3.3 V buck, power LED

g.desc: 5 V priority mux, 3.3 V buck, power LED

g.text: Device USB-C (USB0), ESD (SP0503), fuse, VBUS sense

g.desc: Device USB-C (USB0), ESD (SP0503), fuse, VBUS sense

g.text: Ethernet: termination on ETH_VTERM (off in hibernation, HIB), RBIAS, ESD, MagJack

g.desc: Ethernet: termination on ETH_VTERM (off in hibernation, HIB), RBIAS, ESD, MagJack

g.text: CP2102N USB-UART (on 3.3 V, VBUS sense + bleed)

g.desc: CP2102N USB-UART (on 3.3 V, VBUS sense + bleed)

g.text: EoS TM4C1294 Board, rev A, two BoosterPack-compatible (40-pin) sites, 98-hole breakout, 10/100 Ethernet.

g.desc: EoS TM4C1294 Board, rev A, two BoosterPack-compatible (40-pin) sites, 98-hole breakout, 10/100 Ethernet.

g.text: Values from TI SPMS433B (TM4C1294NCPDT), SPMA056 and SPMZ850G; Silicon Labs CP2102N Rev. 1.5; TI SLVSFG1A,

g.desc: Values from TI SPMS433B (TM4C1294NCPDT), SPMA056 and SPMZ850G; Silicon Labs CP2102N Rev. 1.5; TI SLVSFG1A,

g.text: SLVSDG1C, SLVSAC2G, SLVSDW8B; Littelfuse SP05xxBA and 1206L; Wurth 7499010121A; NDK NX3225GA; Abracon ABS07;

g.desc: SLVSDG1C, SLVSAC2G, SLVSDW8B; Littelfuse SP05xxBA and 1206L; Wurth 7499010121A; NDK NX3225GA; Abracon ABS07;

g.text: Firmware: OSCDRV = 1 (C25/C26 20 pF); USB as a forced device, VBUS on PB1; PD7 is NMI-locked.

g.desc: Firmware: OSCDRV = 1 (C25/C26 20 pF); USB as a forced device, VBUS on PB1; PD7 is NMI-locked.

g.text: HIB switches ETH_VTERM (termination and centre taps) off in hibernation (SPMS433B 7.3.9).

g.desc: HIB switches ETH_VTERM (termination and centre taps) off in hibernation (SPMS433B 7.3.9).

g.text: JP1/JP2: 1-2 + 3-4 = UART0 to the bridge, PD4/PD5 on BP2 A.5/A.6; 1-3 + 2-4 = CAN0 on BP2, bridge on UART2.

g.desc: JP1/JP2: 1-2 + 3-4 = UART0 to the bridge, PD4/PD5 on BP2 A.5/A.6; 1-3 + 2-4 = CAN0 on BP2, bridge on UART2.

g.text: Budget: 5 V pins + 0.75 x 3.3 V pins <= 300 mA in all. 3.3 V and 5 V header pins are outputs.

g.desc: Budget: 5 V pins + 0.75 x 3.3 V pins <= 300 mA in all. 3.3 V and 5 V header pins are outputs.
